# MSSQL Extension for VS Code: Shortcuts Configuration, Enhanced Results Grid Experience, and More

## What Changed

The MSSQL extension for VS Code v1.44 continues to improve the SQL development experience with features that help you work faster and customize your workflow. In this release, we’re introducing the Public Preview of Shortcuts Configuration and an Enhanced Results Grid experience. Together, these updates make it easier to personalize how you work with SQL […]
